test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct logical sequence to form a meaningful sentence.

a. it requires constant sustenance

b. in order for life to be liveable,

c. that enable it to grow and develop

d. and favourable circumstances
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sentence B comes first** as it sets up the context of making life liveable:

 
 
• "In order for life to be liveable,
